feeling_the_flow.goal: Nothing to change. The system is working well.

feeling_the_flow.entrainment: With entrainment, the heart followed the breath into a strong, steady rise and fall.
feeling_the_flow.takeaway: Nothing to change. The system is working well.

fragile_calm.physiology: At rest, the heart rhythm was varied and flexible. With entrainment, the heart followed the breath, but with a limited amplitude.
fragile_calm.implication: The system responded when guided, but didn't have much power.
fragile_calm.goal: A fine result, but maybe a lessened ability to respond.
fragile_calm.baseline: At rest, the heart rhythm was varied and flexible.
fragile_calm.entrainment: With entrainment, the heart followed the breath, but with a limited amplitude.

laser_focus.physiology: At rest, the heart rhythm was strongly ordered, driven by a single dominant pattern. With entrainment, the system responded with full power.
laser_focus.implication: The resting state is organized, and responded with power and depth. This is responsive resilience.
laser_focus.goal: Excellent result. Nothing to correct. If this is your typical pattern, you have robust autonomic reserves available for demands.
laser_focus.baseline: At rest, the heart rhythm was strongly ordered, driven by a single dominant pattern.
laser_focus.entrainment: With entrainment, the system responded with full power.
laser_focus.takeaway: Excellent result. Robust reserves and full responsiveness.

attentive.physiology: At rest, the heart rhythm was strongly ordered, driven by a single dominant pattern. With entrainment, the system responded with limited power.
attentive.implication: A well-organized resting state, but the response lacked depth. The system organized itself when guided, but had limited power to recruit.
attentive.goal: Consider recovery. If you're seeing this pattern often, evaluate rest quality, daily load, or how you felt during the session.
attentive.baseline: At rest, the heart rhythm was strongly ordered, driven by a single dominant pattern.
attentive.entrainment: With entrainment, the system responded with limited power.
attentive.takeaway: Well-organized but shallow response. Consider recovery needs.

stuck.physiology: At rest, the system is preoccupied. With entrainment, the system barely responded.
stuck.implication: The system is busy attending to something and cannot respond to outside stimuli
stuck.goal: Step back and rest. This rhythm needs to loosen before entrainment will be effective. Consider a full break, then retry later.
stuck.baseline: At rest, the system is preoccupied.
stuck.entrainment: With entrainment, the system barely responded.
stuck.takeaway: Too rigid to respond. Step back and rest; loosen before trying again.

relying_on_reserves.physiology: At rest, the system is a bit chaotic. With entrainment, it snapped into a strong, well-organized rhythm, and the vagal response followed with real force.
relying_on_reserves.implication: A relaxed, unstructured resting state that mobilized sharply when requested — occupied at rest, but fully responsive on demand. Both organization and power came online when called.
relying_on_reserves.goal: A strong, responsive result. Nothing to correct. A loose resting rhythm here reflects a system busy with other things, not one running low — it dropped them and responded fully.
relying_on_reserves.baseline: At rest, the system is a bit chaotic.
relying_on_reserves.entrainment: With entrainment, it snapped into a strong, well-organized rhythm, and the vagal response followed with real force.
relying_on_reserves.takeaway: A strong, responsive result. Nothing to correct. A loose resting rhythm here reflects a system busy with other things, not one running low.

running_low.physiology: At rest, the system is a bit chaotic. With entrainment, there was power, but limited coherence.
running_low.implication: The system can increase its response to demand, but the response isn't organized.
running_low.goal: Ease the load or adjust the pace. A slower, steadier breath may let the strong response organize rather than scatter.
running_low.baseline: At rest, the heart rhythm was loose and unstructured.
running_low.entrainment: With entrainment, the vagal response came through with force, but the rhythm never organized into clean coherence.
running_low.takeaway: Ease the load or adjust the pace. A slower, steadier breath may let the strong response organize rather than scatter.

running_on_fumes.physiology: At rest, the system was a bit chaotic. With entrainment, the system did not provide an organized response.
running_on_fumes.implication: Neither settled at rest nor responsive when guided. The system is running on empty right now.
running_on_fumes.goal: Rest. Even slow breathing is a demand at the moment. Stop for now; if it persists, consider illness, stress, or fatigue.
running_on_fumes.baseline: At rest, the system was a bit chaotic.
running_on_fumes.entrainment: With entrainment, the system did not provide an organized response.
running_on_fumes.takeaway: Rest. Even slow breathing is a demand at the moment. Stop for now; if it persists, consider illness, stress, or fatigue.

tug_of_war.physiology: At rest, the system was its usual self. With entrainment, the system was responded but not well organized.
tug_of_war.implication: There was plenty of power, but it did not organize into a smooth rhythm. Common right after waking, after deep recovery, or if the breathing pace was off.
tug_of_war.goal: Give it time. Wait 10-15 minutes and retry, or check that the breathing pace is slow and steady.
tug_of_war.baseline: At rest, the heart rhythm was its usual self.
tug_of_war.entrainment: With entrainment, the system responded but it was not well organized.
tug_of_war.takeaway: Give it time. Wait 10-15 minutes and retry, or check that the breathing pace is slow and steady.
